title: Dragos says unidentified parties accessed confidential data submitted to MiniMax, even after users requested that the company not store or retain their data (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Dragos says unidentified parties accessed confidential data submitted to MiniMax, even after users requested that the company not store or retain their data — Confidential data submitted to Chinese AI startup MiniMax (0100.HK) was accessed by unidentified parties, a cybersecurity researcher told Reuters …
